name: Chart - Room Type Price Benchmark
description: Median and p90 source nightly price by room type, excluding outliers. One row per room type; p90 shows the high-price tail.

stages.native:
SELECT
    room_type,
    'Median price' AS metric,
    CAST(median_price AS FLOAT64) AS value
FROM analytics.mart_room_type_benchmark AS mart_room_type_benchmark
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{room_type}}

UNION ALL

SELECT
    room_type,
    'P90 price' AS metric,
    CAST(p90_price AS FLOAT64) AS value
FROM analytics.mart_room_type_benchmark AS mart_room_type_benchmark
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND {{room_type}}

ORDER BY room_type, metric;
